text:
Sumi: quick idea — add a "wave" rollout primitive to runtime config so console can apply route/quota changes in small cohorts and auto-rollback on KPI signals. would let platform do safe capacity/cost experiments without full blast.

Anya: ui question — how does the console surface each wave? need clear progress + immediate kill switch. also show cohort size + preview before apply. :eyes:

Bryan: API note — i'd prefer a typed shape rather than free-form. something like `waves: [{percent, checks, fallback}]` + an `apply_atomic: bool` flag to control commit semantics. avoids ad-hoc scripts.

Leo: ops considerations — what signals do we gate on? p95 latency, error_rate, and quota_throttle_rate seem obvious. we should require a min sample N and a moving-window (e.g., 5m) before triggering rollback. otherwise noisy bursts will flip rollouts.

Raj: telemetry / tracing — recommend tagging requests with `cohort_id` so traces/metrics can be sliced. also need a dedicated metric for `config_apply_failures` and a trace span emitted by the router when a cohort is evaluated.

Maya: product ask — can first wave be a soft-preview (no billing changes) so product can validate UX without cost impact? we should support a dry-run mode from console.

Bryan: also discuss fallback policies. two useful defaults: 1) route fallback to cheaper model variant 2) reduce quota for the cohort and keep traffic on main route. need to make fallback pluggable.

Sumi: here's a minimal example of the config i had in mind:```json
{
  "config_id": "route-6727",
  "waves": [
    {"percent": 5, "duration_minutes": 30, "checks": ["p95_latency<200","error_rate<0.5%"]},
    {"percent": 25, "duration_minutes": 30, "checks": ["p95_latency<220","error_rate<1%"]},
    {"percent": 100, "duration_minutes": 0}
  ],
  "fallback": {"type":"model_variant","variant":"fast32q"},
  "dry_run": false
}
```

Leo: implementation rule-of-thumb — automatic rollback if any configured check trips for 3 consecutive evaluation windows. require manual override with a TTL to prevent accidental sticking. also add an opt-in `notify_on_rollback` hook (pager/email).

Anya: console UX: timeline view with per-wave success bars, a live log stream, ability to pause/skip next wave, and an explicit `force_continue` that requires two-step confirmation. small visuals: donut for health, sparkline for p95.

Raj: backend detail — apply should flow router -> quota service -> billing adapter. each step must be idempotent and emit an `apply_status` event with cohort_id. that event powers the console timeline and the telemetry pipeline. sampling for traces should be increased for affected cohorts for first 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — draft: add wave rollout API + basic console hooks. CI: ✅ unit, ❌ e2e flaky on quota-sim.

Sumi: next steps: write RFC with concrete fields + signal definitions. volunteers: Bryan (api) + Raj (telemetry) + Anya (ux) + Maya (product) + Leo (ops). i'll own the RFC doc and coordination. anyone else?

Bryan: I'll pick up the API draft and iterate on the schema. aiming to push a proto PR by EOD and include sample schema tests.

Maya: will mock console screens for the dry-run + timeline, dropping designs in Figma link later.

Leo: i'll prototype the rollback detector and a small sim to validate thresholds.

Anya: can we also add an accessibility checklist for the console controls (keyboard + screenreader) while we design?

Sumi: great — thanks all. will kick off RFC and ping this thread when it's up. :thumbsup:
